extracted.name: Ham Ball
extracted.description: This ham ball features softened cream cheese, chopped ham, and green onion rolled in chopped pecans for a great dip to serve with crackers or bread.
ingredient_lines: 2 (8 ounce) packages cream cheese, slightly softened
0.25 teaspoon seasoned salt, or to taste
1 cup chopped pecans, or more to taste
instruction_lines: Mix together cream cheese, ham, green onions, and seasoned salt in a large bowl until evenly mixed; roll into a ball.
Spread pecans onto a flat surface. Roll ham ball in pecans to coat.
